description:
Request campaign funding for a campaign the caller's organization owns. Starcovery Payouts runs concierge: this call records one open funding request for the accepted creators not yet funded, per person, with the quoted total (compensation per creator times those people, plus the platform fee that the market information answer sets), and notifies the Starcovery team, who invoice the organization. No money moves by this call.

Only organization owners and admins may call it. Needs a saved contract, an answered market information question, and at least one creator who accepted and is not yet funded. Returns a tool error naming the reason when the campaign is not the caller's, it is archived, a step is missing, or a request is already open; reopen an archived campaign with update_campaign status active first. The reason creators_changed means a creator accepted while the request was prepared, and the caller repeats the same call.

Returns the request row with amountCents set to the quoted total. Needs a credential.
name: fund_campaign

resolvedAt.description: Null while the request is open. Set when staff record the reserve.

title: Fund campaign
